chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, is not unjust to His servants in His decree and judgment, but He is Just in that.
ai.seo_question: How does Shia theology explain divine justice in relation to Allah's decree?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifying that divine decree (qada') and judgment (hukm) are rooted in absolute justice (adl), directly countering the Mu'tazila and Khawarij views that linked destiny to arbitrary divine will. This narration underscores the Shia doctrine that Allah’s actions are never unjust, ensuring that human accountability remains meaningful within the framework of predestination.
